name: dumbbell-chart
title: Dumbbell chart
description: Change per item as two dots joined by a line: before and after, plan and actual. Green when good, red when bad.
htmlExample:
<bef-dumbbell-chart class="w-[34rem] max-w-full" from-label="2025" to-label="2026" :rows='[{"label":"Engineering","from":62,"to":78},{"label":"Sales","from":71,"to":69},{"label":"Support","from":55,"to":74},{"label":"Marketing","from":68,"to":81},{"label":"Finance","from":80,"to":77}]' id="g1"></bef-dumbbell-chart>
<script type="module">
document.getElementById("g1").props = {
  format: (n) => `${n}%`,
};
</script>
